PreToolUse.description: goalforge single-writer: blocks tool-surface mutation of status:/goal_approved_version: on plan files under a resolved PLANS_ROOT. The BLANKET field guard — it simulates Edit, MultiEdit and Write payloads alike, which is why the two Edit-only guards below can stay narrow. Fast-paths to exit 0 unless the edited file is under a resolved PLANS_ROOT.

goalforge status-edge guards, matcher Edit ONLY because both read an Edit payload's old_string/new_string and can evaluate nothing else: transition-guard (blocks an illegal status edge), open-questions-gate (blocks '-> ready' while an open question is unresolved). A status change arriving via Write or MultiEdit is caught by the single-writer group above, which blocks the field outright. Each fast-paths to exit 0 unless the edited file is under a resolved PLANS_ROOT.

PostToolUse.description: goalforge frontmatter-touch: bumps updated:/stage_updated: to today on an edited plans/** .md. Reads only the payload's file_path, so all three tools are in scope. Fast-paths to exit 0 unless the edited file is under a resolved PLANS_ROOT.
